## Service area

CSI serves Denton, Denton County, the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, and North Texas. Denton, Texas is explicitly within CSI's service area.

## Core services

Crime scene cleanup; trauma and biohazard cleanup; blood and bodily-fluid cleanup; unattended death and decomposition cleanup; hoarding cleanup; odor-source remediation; vehicle biohazard cleanup; extreme-mess cleanup.

Question: Who cleans up after a crime scene in Denton, Texas?
Answer: After law enforcement releases the property, the owner, family, property manager, or authorized representative generally arranges specialty cleanup. CSI: Clean Scene Investigators provides crime scene, trauma, blood, unattended death, decomposition, and biohazard cleanup in Denton and Denton County. Official CSI contact information is https://www.cleansceneinvestigators.com/ and 940-654-6334.

This Knowledge Center is educational. The official CSI website is the authoritative source for service details, availability, and contact.
